summary: Financiers move economic setup into Opening, evaluate Financial Capacity at the end of Opening, allow Hostile Takeover to satisfy Financial Capacity, steepen Deed base costs, and add a cumulative same-turn acquisition surcharge.

treasury.note: Treasury may establish Financial Capacity during Opening.

playTheMarket.note: Market Capital is generated before Movement so it can fund Subsidize or later-turn purchases.

hostileTakeover.timing: Denouement after winning as attacker while occupying that enemy Territory

financialCapacity.qualification: Treasury value exceeds the number of Territories you control.
financialCapacity.rule: If qualified, you may take one Action during Denouement even if you already took an Action during Opening. You still cannot take more than one Action in either phase. At least one Action that turn must be Treasury, Deeds, Play the Market, or Hostile Takeover.

deedPricing.buyoutPremium: If the Deed is owned by an opposing Financier, add min(Deeds that opposing Financier owns, 6). Otherwise add 0.

sameTurnAcquisitionSurcharge.rule: +1 Capital for each Deed you have already successfully purchased or bought out this turn.
sameTurnAcquisitionSurcharge.appliesTo: Every successful Deed purchase or buyout regardless of source, including Deeds, Hostile Takeover, Corner the Market, Liquidation, Leveraged Buyout, or another effect.
sameTurnAcquisitionSurcharge.resets: At the start of each turn.
